tagline: Order the night before, collect it still warm.
one_liner: A neighbourhood bakery that takes preorders online and has your bread, pastries and cakes bagged and waiting at the counter.

positioning.who_its_for: Locals who want good bread on a weekend morning without queueing for it, and who plan a day or two ahead.
positioning.what_problem: The good loaves sell out by 9am, and everything left after that is what nobody else wanted.
positioning.why_them: We bake to the preorder list first, so what you reserved is set aside under your name before the doors open.

products.name: Weekend Loaf Preorder
products.description: Reserve a wild-yeast sourdough loaf for Saturday or Sunday pickup, baked the morning you collect it.
features: 900g wild-yeast sourdough, baked the morning of pickup
Choose Saturday or Sunday at checkout

products.name: Pastry Box Preorder
products.description: A box of six pastries from whatever we are laminating that week, collected on the morning you choose.
features: Nut-free box on request in the order notes

products.name: Standing Bread Order
products.description: A weekly standing preorder — two loaves put aside for the same pickup day every week.
features: Pause or cancel any week before Thursday

do: Talk about the bake and the pickup time in concrete terms
Write the way a baker would say it across the counter
dont: Promise delivery or shipping of any kind
Claim health or dietary benefits we can't back up
